title: Take a bath (ghusl)
text: Bathing on Friday is strongly emphasised for every adult attending Jumu‘ah.

title: Use the miswak / brush your teeth
text: The Prophet ﷺ encouraged ghusl, using the miswak and wearing perfume on Friday.

title: Wear perfume (men)
text: Apply some fragrance if you have it.

title: Wear your best clean clothes
text: Wear the best clothes you have for Jumu‘ah.
ref: Sunan Abi Dawud 343 (hasan); Sunan Ibn Majah 1096

title: Go to the masjid early
text: Whoever comes earliest earns a reward like offering a camel, then a cow, a ram, a hen and an egg — and the angels close their records when the imam comes out.

title: Walk if you can
text: Whoever bathes, goes early, walks rather than rides, sits close to the imam, listens and does not speak idly earns the reward of a year of fasting and night prayer for every step.
ref: Sunan Abi Dawud 345; Sunan an-Nasa’i 1381; Jami‘ at-Tirmidhi 496 (sahih)

title: Pray two rak‘ahs on arrival
when: On entering, even during the khutbah
text: Do not sit until you have prayed two short rak‘ahs — even if the imam is already giving the khutbah.

title: Sit close to the imam
text: Sit near the front and don’t step over people’s shoulders to get there.

title: Listen silently to the khutbah
text: Even saying “be quiet” to someone during the khutbah is idle talk. Don’t use your phone.

title: Read Surah al-Kahf
when: Any time on Friday (from Maghrib on Thursday)
text: Whoever reads Surah al-Kahf on Friday will have a light between the two Fridays.
ref: al-Hakim, al-Mustadrak 3392; al-Bayhaqi (sahih per al-Albani, Sahih al-Jami‘ 6470)

title: Send abundant salawat on the Prophet ﷺ
text: Increase your blessings on the Prophet ﷺ on Friday, for they are presented to him.
ref: Sunan Abi Dawud 1047; Sunan Ibn Majah 1085 (sahih)

title: Make dua in the hour of acceptance
when: Especially the last hour before Maghrib
text: There is an hour on Friday in which no Muslim asks Allah for good except that He gives it. Many scholars held it to be the last hour after ‘Asr.
ref: Sahih al-Bukhari 935; Sahih Muslim 852; Sunan Abi Dawud 1048

title: Pray the sunnah after Jumu‘ah
text: Pray four rak‘ahs after Jumu‘ah in the masjid, or two at home.

title: Fajr in congregation
text: The Prophet ﷺ used to recite Surah as-Sajdah and Surah al-Insan in Fajr on Friday.

title: Don’t single out Friday for fasting
text: Don’t fast Friday alone — fast a day before or after it too.
